_about: The ERIX voice library on the ERIX Voice page: every Sarvam bulbul:v3 speaker a customer can pick (voice-runtime config/voices.py V3_SPEAKERS). Each voice introduces itself by name. The Hindi line avoids gendered verbs so every voice can say it. Rendered by scripts/voice-samples.py --set library.

lines.en: Hello, my name is {name}. Whether you want to book an appointment or ask a question, just tell me. How can I help you today?
lines.hi: नमस्ते, मेरा नाम {name} है। Appointment book करनी हो या कोई सवाल पूछना हो, बताइए। आज आपकी क्या मदद करूँ?
lines.te: నమస్కారం, నా పేరు {name}. Appointment book చేయాలన్నా, ఏదైనా అడగాలన్నా చెప్పండి. ఈరోజు మీకు ఎలా సహాయం చేయగలను?
